sentences.en: Representatives made a major breakthrough in the trade talks.
sentences.zh: 代表们在贸易谈判中取得了重大突破。

sentences.en: He badly exaggerated his ability to achieve a breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 他严重夸大了自己能够取得突破的能力。

sentences.en: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
sentences.zh: 大多数科学突破无非就是发现了显而易见的东西。

senses.zh: 突破，重大进展；突破性进展，重大发现

mnemonic: 合成词：break（打破）+through（通过）→打破，突破
